name: Blackjack
summary: Hit or stand against the dealer, with live soft totals and automatic bust detection.

nextActions.label: Deal hands

branches.narration: You hit. Hit again or stand.

nextActions.narration: Hands dealt. The dealer shows one card. Hit or stand.

instructions: Blackjack. Goal: beat the dealer without going over 21. Number cards = face value, face cards = 10, Aces = 1 or 11 (whichever is better). The dealer must hit until they have at least 17. Flow: 1) Bet 10. 2) Deal: player gets two face-up cards, dealer gets one face-up and one hole card. 3) Player hits or stands; bust (over 21) loses immediately. 4) Reveal the dealer's hole card, score the dealer, and draw until the dealer has 17+. 5) Settle: if player wins, call award_pot(['human']) to return the bet and award_chips('human', 10) for even-money profit (award_chips('human', 15) for a natural Blackjack). If dealer wins, call award_pot(['bot_1']). On a push, award_pot(['human']).
openingNarration: Blackjack ready. Bet 10, then deal the cards.
